node.statement: By 1.5 applied to the index i whose row point is p_v (the display row), the transverse component of the fiber-aggregated idempotence equation reads x_v = sum_Q c^{(v)}_Q * x_Q, where c^{(v)}_Q are the display row's fiber-aggregated masses.
